- Added a leaderboard for Junimo Kart endless mode
- Added a leaderboard for the deepest mine level reached in Skull Cavern

results.description:
Move to the countryside, and cultivate a new life in this award-winning open-ended farming RPG! With over 50+ hours of gameplay content and new Mobile-specific features, such as auto-save and multiple controls options.

**Winner of the Golden Joysticks' Breakthrough Award**
**Nominee of Game of the Year 2017 - BAFTA Games Awards**

---

BUILD THE FARM OF YOUR DREAMS:

■ Turn your overgrown fields into a lively and bountiful farm

■ Raise and breed happy animals, grow a variety of seasonal crops and design your farm, your way

■ Customize your farmer and home! With hundreds of options to choose from

■ Settle down and start a family with 12 potential marriage candidates

■ Become part of the community by taking part in seasonal festivals and villager quests

■ Explore vast, mysterious caves, encountering dangerous monsters and valuable treasure

■ Spend a relaxing afternoon at one of the local fishing spots or go crabbing by the seaside

■ Forage, grow crops and produce artisan goods to cook up as a delicious meal

■ Rebuilt for touch-screen gameplay on iOS with mobile-specific features, such as auto-select to toggle quickly between your farming tools and auto-attack to swiftly take down fiendish monsters in the mines

■ Continue farming from where you last left off with auto-save (even if you close the app!)

■ Play the game your way with multiple controls options, such as touch-screen and virtual joystick

■ Newly Updated Single Player Content - Including new town upgrades, dating events, crops, fishing ponds, hats, clothing, and new pets! Plus more to be discovered...

---

“The best version of Stardew Valley is the one you have with you … This game is absolutely incredible, and will not disappoint.” - TouchArcade

"Stardew Valley beautifully combines farm simulation with RPG elements to create an intriguing, absorbing rural world." - IGN

“Far more than just a farming game... filled with seemingly endless content and heart.” Giant Bomb

"Village life has never been so accessible and satisfying" - The Telegraph

“Stardew Valley has been the most rich and heartwarming experience I’ve had in a game in years.” CG Magazine

---

Note: Features new 1.6 update story content, multiplayer functionality not supported. No in-app purchases.

results.description:
Looking for help or the latest tips for Stardew Valley? This all-in-one solution is exactly what you need to enhance your gameplay and improve your skills. It caters to both novice and experienced players and, once downloaded, does not require an internet connection for daily use—ensuring that essential information is always at your fingertips.

Languages:
The database is available in the following languages:
• Chinese (中文)
• English
• French (Français)
• German (Deutsch)
• Hungarian (Magyar)
• Italian (Italiano)
• Japanese (日本語)
• Korean (한국어)
• Portuguese (Português)
• Russian (Русский)
• Spanish (Español)
• Turkish (Türkçe)

Features:
• Achievements
• Crafting
• Drops
• Environment details
• Guides
• Hints
• In-game news
• Items
• Quests
• Recipes
• Tips
• Tricks
• Videos

Additional Benefits:
• Ability to add or remove objects from favorites
• Ability to sort objects by category, name, or type
• Customizable font size, style, and color themes for a personalized reading experience
• Dark theme for comfortable viewing
• Easy navigation throughout the app
• Interconnected objects: navigate from a recipe directly to its ingredients and explore related items seamlessly
• List of recently viewed objects for quick reference
• Optimized for both iPad and iPhone
• Powerful text search and object name search functionality
• Works offline once the database is downloaded (internet connection required only for heavy files like videos or animated GIFs)
• Zoom functionality for images and text

Content Overview:
• Comprehensive guides, hints, tips, and tricks to support both beginners and experienced players
• Detailed information on items and recipes, including images, ingredients, and stats
• Latest news and engaging videos about Stardew Valley

Performance:
The app is fully optimized for all Apple mobile devices. With the database downloaded, you can access all essential game information even in offline scenarios such as when you’re on the subway.


Feedback:
For any requests, suggestions, or comments, please use the "Feedback" option within the app or email me at kateryna.momotova@yahoo.com. Your positive reviews are highly appreciated, and if you would like to help with translations, please get in touch via email.


License:
Content is available under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0) unless otherwise noted.

Note:
This app is unofficial and is not affiliated with the game’s developer, publisher, or distributor. All in-game content, imagery, text, and videos are the property of their respective owners. This reference app is designed solely for informational purposes to assist fans alongside playing the game. It may include information sourced from freely available online resources. If you have any concerns or believe there is a copyright or trademark issue that falls outside of "fair use," please contact me directly at kateryna.momotova@yahoo.com.


Subscription Details:
Your payment will be charged to your iTunes account once you confirm your purchase. Your iTunes account will be charged again when your subscription automatically renews at the end of your current period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the period’s end. You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID account settings at any time after purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://telegra.ph/Terms--Conditions-02-13.

Terms & Conditions: https://telegra.ph/Privacy-Policy-02-13-6.
